error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot do this. Nothing changed.
error.MEDIA_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED: No media provider is configured for this workspace. Configure one under Providers first.
error.MEDIA_CAPABILITY_MISSING: The configured provider has no video model assigned to the media role.
error.MEDIA_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The media provider is not ready (for example, its key is missing). Nothing was charged.
error.MEDIA_PRICING_UNAVAILABLE: The media role has no reviewed rate card, so no cost can be estimated. Nothing was charged.
error.MEDIA_EPISODE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: That episode is not part of this learner's release.
error.MEDIA_CAPTIONS_REQUIRED: Approval needs WebVTT captions with at least one cue.
error.MEDIA_TEXT_ALTERNATIVE_REQUIRED: Approval needs a transcript and a description of what the video shows.
error.MEDIA_REVIEW_FINDINGS_INCOMPLETE: Approval needs every review check confirmed. Reject the clip instead.
error.MEDIA_ASSET_CHANGED: The stored clip changed since you opened it. Reload and review again.
error.MEDIA_NOT_UNDER_REVIEW: This job is no longer waiting for review.
error.MEDIA_NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved clip can be attached.
error.MEDIA_PUBLICATION_DENIED: Current course policy does not allow publishing to this learner now (closed, past a deadline or no longer a member). Nothing was shown.
error.MEDIA_EXPIRY_INVALID: Choose an expiry between now and 180 days.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A different request already used this retry key. Start again.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Some fields are missing or out of range.
error.refused: The media service refused this ({reason}). Nothing was published.
error.unavailable: The media service is unavailable. Nothing was published.
failure.MEDIA_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: refused: the workspace or learner paid-work allowance cannot cover the per-job reservation
failure.MEDIA_PER_JOB_LIMIT: refused: the estimate exceeds the per-job allowance
failure.MEDIA_POLICY_DENIED: refused: current course policy does not allow new work
failure.MEDIA_CAPACITY: refused: too many media jobs are already running
failure.MEDIA_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: the provider never confirmed the submission; it was not resent
failure.MEDIA_PROVIDER_FAILED: the provider reported a failed render
failure.MEDIA_ASSET_INVALID: the returned file was not a supported video
failure.MEDIA_ASSET_TOO_LARGE: the returned file exceeded the size limit
error.MEDIA_FACTUAL_CHECK_FAILED: The automatic check found that the text you entered contradicts the approved script, storyboard or reference visual. If the clip really shows this, reject it; if you mistyped, correct the text.
error.MEDIA_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: That course visual is not part of this release. Choose another or leave it empty.
error.MEDIA_CLIP_TOOLCHAIN_MISSING: Exact clips are not set up on this server. An administrator needs to set CLIP_RASTERIZER_PATH and CLIP_FFMPEG_PATH and restart the API.
error.MEDIA_CLIP_RANGE_INVALID: The start and end must fall inside the visual and span at most 20 seconds.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_NOT_FOUND: That storyboard no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_NOT_APPROVED: Shots can only be made from an approved storyboard. Ask a reviewer to approve it first.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_SHOT_MISMATCH: This shot is planned as a different kind of media. Use the shot's own button.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft storyboard can be changed or reviewed. Start a new storyboard instead.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_REVISION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this storyboard since you opened it. Reload and try again.
error.MEDIA_STORYBOARD_DRAFT_PENDING: The shots are not ready yet. Wait for the draft, or write the shots yourself, then approve.
error.MEDIA_SHOT_DURATION_UNSUPPORTED: A generated shot asks for a length the video model does not offer. Edit the shot to a supported length.
error.MEDIA_COMPOSITION_INCOMPLETE: Every shot needs an approved clip before they can be joined.
error.MEDIA_ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: No AI reviewer model is ready for this workspace. Assign one under AI services, or write the shots yourself.
error.MEDIA_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The paid-work allowance cannot cover this. Raise the budget under AI services, or wait. Nothing was charged.
error.MEDIA_POLICY_DENIED: Current course policy does not allow new paid work for this learner. Nothing was charged.
error.MEDIA_PROMPT_TOO_LONG: The text is longer than the model accepts. Shorten it.
error.MEDIA_CHECK_IN_PROGRESS: This check is still running. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_TOOLCHAIN_MISSING: the clip tools are not set up on this server
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_TOOLCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE: the clip tools could not be started
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_SCENE_INVALID: the course visual failed its check or was removed
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_RANGE_INVALID: the time range does not fit the visual
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_TOO_LARGE: the rendered clip exceeded the size limit
failure.MEDIA_CLIP_ENCODER_FAILED: the clip could not be encoded
finding.quantityScript: Says {subject} is {found}, but the script says {expected}.
finding.quantityReference: Says {subject} is {found}, but the course visual shows {expected}.
finding.quantityUnsupported: Says {subject} is {found}, which the sources never state. Check it.
finding.claimContradicted: The AI reviewer found that "{claim}" contradicts: "{quote}".
finding.claimUnsupported: The AI reviewer found no source for: "{claim}".
finding.quoteNotFound: The AI reviewer claimed a contradiction for "{claim}" but quoted nothing from the sources, so it was ignored.
finding.durationMismatch: Lasts {found} s, but {expected} s were asked for.
finding.aspectMismatch: The picture is {found}, but the aspect ratio {expected} was asked for.
finding.resolutionMismatch: The picture is {found}, but {expected} was asked for.
finding.blankFrames: {found} of {expected} sampled frames are blank (one flat colour).
finding.noMotion: Nothing visibly moves in the sampled frames. Check that it is not a still picture.
finding.fewerCuts: Shows {found} distinct shots, but the storyboard has {expected}. Check that every shot is there.
finding.unreadable: The file could not be read for the frame check.
finding.inspectionBusy: Another frame check was running. Run the check again.
finding.inspectionUnavailable: The frame check needs ffmpeg and ffprobe on the server. Ask the operator to set them up.
